Accessibility.question: Supports keyboard-only navigation
Accessibility.recommendation: Test and remediate all core workflows so they can be completed using only a keyboard.

Accessibility.question: Provides alternative text for non-text content
Accessibility.recommendation: Add meaningful alternative text to images, icons and other non-text content.

Accessibility.question: Maintains sufficient colour contrast and readable fonts
Accessibility.recommendation: Apply accessible contrast ratios and readable typography across the user interface.

Accessibility.question: Compatible with screen readers and assistive technologies
Accessibility.recommendation: Test key journeys with screen readers and other assistive technologies and resolve identified issues.

Accessibility.question: Supports responsive design across devices
Accessibility.recommendation: Validate and optimize the interface for supported desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

Accessibility.question: Provides captions/transcripts for multimedia outputs
Accessibility.recommendation: Provide captions for video and transcripts for audio wherever multimedia is used.

Accessibility.question: Error messages are clear and accessible
Accessibility.recommendation: Rewrite error messages to clearly state the problem and the action the user should take.

Accessibility.question: Supports multiple languages where required
Accessibility.recommendation: Identify required user languages and provide validated localization where there is a business or accessibility need.

Accessibility.question: Conforms to recognized accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG)
Accessibility.recommendation: Perform a formal accessibility review against the applicable WCAG level and remediate gaps.

Accessibility.question: Accessibility testing is performed before deployment
Accessibility.recommendation: Add accessibility testing to pre-release acceptance criteria and retain test evidence.

Bias Mitigation.question: Training data reviewed for representativeness
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Document the populations and use cases represented in the data and assess material representation gaps.

Bias Mitigation.question: Bias testing performed before deployment
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Introduce documented pre-deployment bias testing for relevant user groups and use cases.

Bias Mitigation.question: Fairness metrics documented
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Define, calculate and document fairness metrics appropriate to the AI system's context and risk.

Bias Mitigation.question: Bias mitigation techniques implemented
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Implement and document mitigation actions for material bias identified during testing.

Bias Mitigation.question: Sensitive attributes handled appropriately
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Define controls for collection, use, access and protection of sensitive attributes.

Bias Mitigation.question: Human review exists for high-risk decisions
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Require meaningful human review and escalation for decisions with material impact on people.

Bias Mitigation.question: Bias monitoring performed after deployment
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Establish periodic post-deployment bias monitoring with defined thresholds and owners.

Bias Mitigation.question: Bias incidents are documented and investigated
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Create a bias incident process covering reporting, investigation, corrective action and closure.

Bias Mitigation.question: Model retraining considers fairness improvements
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Include fairness findings and metrics as explicit criteria in retraining and model-update decisions.

Bias Mitigation.question: Governance process exists for bias management
Bias Mitigation.recommendation: Assign accountability and establish a documented governance process for bias and fairness risks.

Transparency.question: Purpose of the AI system is documented
Transparency.recommendation: Maintain an approved description of the system's intended purpose, users and permitted use cases.

Transparency.question: Users are informed when interacting with AI
Transparency.recommendation: Clearly disclose to users when they are interacting with or receiving content from an AI system.

Transparency.question: Model limitations are documented
Transparency.recommendation: Document known limitations, failure modes and situations where the AI should not be relied upon.

Transparency.question: Data sources are documented
Transparency.recommendation: Maintain traceable documentation of material data and knowledge sources used by the system.

Transparency.question: Decision logic is explainable where applicable
Transparency.recommendation: Provide explanations appropriate to the impact and context of AI-supported decisions.

Transparency.question: Confidence or uncertainty is communicated when appropriate
Transparency.recommendation: Review and strengthen this control; document supporting evidence.

Transparency.question: Version history of the model is maintained
Transparency.recommendation: Maintain a traceable version history for models and material system components.

Transparency.question: Model documentation is regularly updated
Transparency.recommendation: Define an owner and review cycle to keep model and system documentation current.

Transparency.question: Responsible AI policies are publicly available or internally documented
Transparency.recommendation: Document responsible AI requirements and make them accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Transparency.question: Transparency requirements are periodically reviewed
Transparency.recommendation: Establish periodic reviews of disclosures, documentation and explainability requirements.

Auditability.question: Model versions are traceable
Auditability.recommendation: Implement version control and retain deployment records linking production use to specific model versions.

Auditability.question: Training datasets are version controlled
Auditability.recommendation: Version and retain material datasets so training or tuning runs can be reproduced and audited.

Auditability.question: Configuration changes are recorded
Auditability.recommendation: Log material configuration changes with date, owner, rationale and approval.

Auditability.question: Assessment results are archived
Auditability.recommendation: Retain ESG, risk and control assessment results according to a defined records-retention policy.

Auditability.question: User actions can be audited
Auditability.recommendation: Capture sufficient user activity records to support investigation and audit while respecting privacy requirements.

Auditability.question: Inference requests are traceable
Auditability.recommendation: Retain appropriate request and response traceability with access, privacy and retention controls.

Auditability.question: Model changes require approval
Auditability.recommendation: Introduce documented approval gates for material model or AI-system changes.

Auditability.question: Periodic internal audits are conducted
Auditability.recommendation: Establish a risk-based internal audit or independent review schedule for the AI system.

Auditability.question: Evidence supporting compliance is retained
Auditability.recommendation: Maintain a controlled evidence repository linked to relevant requirements and assessments.

Auditability.question: Audit findings are tracked to closure
Auditability.recommendation: Assign owners and due dates to audit findings and track corrective actions through verified closure.

Logging & Monitoring.question: System performance is continuously monitored
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Define operational performance indicators and continuously monitor them against thresholds.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Inference logs are retained securely
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Define secure logging, access controls and retention periods for inference records.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Security events are monitored
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Integrate relevant AI-system security events into organizational security monitoring and response processes.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Model drift is monitored
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Define drift indicators, thresholds and review actions appropriate to the model and use case.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Data quality is monitored
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Monitor material input and reference-data quality indicators and establish remediation triggers.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Alerts exist for abnormal behaviour
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Configure alerts for material anomalies, failures, misuse and unexpected system behaviour.

Logging & Monitoring.question: System availability is monitored
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Monitor availability and service health against agreed service objectives.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Incident response procedures are defined
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Maintain an AI-specific incident response and escalation procedure integrated with enterprise incident management.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Monitoring dashboards are regularly reviewed
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Assign owners and a review cadence for monitoring dashboards and retain evidence of material reviews.

Logging & Monitoring.question: Monitoring results drive continuous improvement
Logging & Monitoring.recommendation: Translate monitoring findings into tracked corrective and preventive improvement actions.

baseline.H6: Define, calculate and document fairness metrics appropriate to the AI system's context and risk.
